<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="24" fill="#F5C418"/>
  <text x="20" y="16" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">9:41</text>
  <line x1="329" y1="15" x2="329" y2="11" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="15" x2="334" y2="9" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="339" y1="15" x2="339" y2="7" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="351" cy="12" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="348" y1="12" x2="354" y2="12" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="365" y="7" width="19" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="9" width="13" height="7" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
  <rect x="385" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
  
  <!-- yellow header -->
  <rect x="0" y="24" width="390" height="60" fill="#F5C418"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="43" width="34" height="22" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="37" y="59" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#F5C418">IMDb</text>
  </g>
  <text x="74" y="60" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Create your account</text>
  
  <!-- intro -->
  <text x="20" y="113" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4F4F4F">Join IMDb to rate movies, save favorites, and more.</text>
  
  <!-- username -->
  <text x="20" y="143" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Username</text>
  <rect x="20" y="151" width="350" height="44" rx="8" fill="#0000001A"/>
  <rect x="20" y="149" width="350" height="44" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="171" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="184" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="59" y="176" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">jordan_miles</text>
  
  <!-- email -->
  <text x="20" y="218" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Email address</text>
  <rect x="20" y="226" width="350" height="44" rx="8" fill="#0000001A"/>
  <rect x="20" y="224" width="350" height="44" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="34" y="239" width="17" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="35,240 42.5,246 50,240" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="59" y="251" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">jordan.miles@email.com</text>
  
  <!-- password -->
  <text x="20" y="293" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Password</text>
  <rect x="20" y="301" width="350" height="44" rx="8" fill="#0000001A"/>
  <rect x="20" y="299" width="350" height="44" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="34" y="317" width="14" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="37,317 37,313 41,310 45,313 45,317" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="343" cy="321" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <line x1="339" y1="325" x2="347" y2="317" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <text x="59" y="326" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">••••••••••</text>
  
  <!-- confirmation -->
  <text x="20" y="368" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Confirm password</text>
  <rect x="20" y="376" width="350" height="44" rx="8" fill="#0000001A"/>
  <rect x="20" y="374" width="350" height="44" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="34" y="392" width="14" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="37,392 37,388 41,385 45,388 45,392" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="343" cy="396" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <line x1="339" y1="400" x2="347" y2="392" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <text x="59" y="401" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">••••••••••</text>
  <text x="20" y="438" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Use at least 8 characters with a number or symbol.</text>
  
  <!-- remember -->
  <rect x="20" y="457" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="#F5C418" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="24,466 28,470 35,462" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="48" y="471" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Remember me</text>
  <text x="370" y="471" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Keep me signed in</text>
  
  <!-- create button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="492" width="350" height="48" rx="8" fill="#0000001A"/>
    <rect x="20" y="490" width="350" height="48" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
    <text x="195" y="520" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Create account</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- divider -->
  <line x1="20" y1="563" x2="166" y2="563" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="568" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">OR SIGN UP WITH</text>
  <line x1="224" y1="563" x2="370" y2="563" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="580" width="169" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="601" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="48" y="606" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">G</text>
    <text x="112" y="606" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Google</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="580" width="169" height="42" rx="8" fill="#333333"/>
    <circle cx="229" cy="601" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="229" y="607" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">f</text>
    <text x="294" y="606" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Facebook</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- login prompt -->
  <text x="126" y="659" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4F4F4F">Already have an account?</text>
  <text x="273" y="659" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Log in</text>
  <line x1="252" y1="662" x2="294" y2="662" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- terms -->
  <text x="195" y="696" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">By continuing, you agree to IMDb's Terms of Use.</text>
  
  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="42,799 52,791 62,799" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="46" y="798" width="12" height="10" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="52" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="145" cy="798" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="151" y1="804" x2="157" y2="810" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="145" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <polyline points="235,792 235,808 248,804 261,808 261,792" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="248" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Wishlist</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="337" cy="796" r="5" fill="#F2C94C" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <ellipse cx="337" cy="808" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#F2C94C" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="337" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
